findings.summary: The new GD.goals summary contains unquoted commas inside a YAML flow mapping, so the parsed summary is cut off at 'An owner-only goal with an interval' and the rest of the text becomes stray keys.
findings.evidence: Diff: `summary: An owner-only goal with an interval, chosen from presets or typed, and a desired depth, with a schedule preview.` inside `{ ... }`; the graph slice shows GD.goals summary: 'An owner-only goal with an interval'. The depth and schedule preview parts are lost.

findings.summary: The criterion now says fixtures cover 'interval preset' changes, which can be read as narrowing coverage so that typed (non-preset) interval changes are no longer required to be tested.
findings.evidence: Old: 'interval and depth changes'. New: 'interval preset and depth changes'. Meanwhile component.GoalIntervalField and J.goals/g3 still allow any intervalDays from 1 through 3650.
